name: pipelex
description: Build and run AI methods from your agent with Pipelex: skills that write them in MTHDS, a hook that checks every edit, and the Pipelex tools.

api_key.title: Pipelex API key
api_key.description: API key for the hosted Pipelex API, which validates bundles and runs methods. Get one at https://app.pipelex.com. Leave empty to use the key saved by `npx -y @pipelex/mcp@latest login`, or PIPELEX_API_KEY from your shell; the validation hook validates only with a key given here or in your shell, and otherwise lints and formats.
